title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings

meta.Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I didn't realize you were here.
Thank you for always watching over everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The others are here with me today, so why don't we all chat for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hiya!
Hehe. I'm so glad you're here♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were actually just talking about everyone's SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Did you know that they've been changing bit by bit lately?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it seems that new areas and little sprouts have been appearing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is that because everyone's been growing so much?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Probably.
They've all experienced quite a lot up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Four set out to become professional musicians and have made big strides in their journey...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some are working hard as idols each day in order to spread hope to as many people as they can...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Others overcame a series of walls and obstacles on their way to surpassing that legendary night...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One group even set out to perform at new and different places in order to make their dreams a reality...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And some have come face to face with tough facts as they try to find their true selves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of them discovered their true feelings, experienced many things and felt a myriad of different emotions...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those thoughts and feelings have begun to change each SEKAI little by little.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, something over there is twinkling...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Could it be a fragment of somebody's feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it doesn't look like any ordinary fragment...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Could it be that the SEKAI are trying to tell us something...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If so, I'd like to try touching it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too!
I can't wait to find out what sorts of feelings it represents♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me neither. Especially if it has something to do with all the others!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Aren't they...? Ichika and the girls...?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Oh yeah, I think I saw something about it on TV this morning.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Really?
Does that mean we can see more if we wait here for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: A meteor shower... That must look amazing.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Just making a wish that we could stay like this forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Playing together, talking about stuff, watching shooting stars on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could keep doing all that together forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish we could stay like this forever...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now I see... Everything started from here for them...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, why don't we try playing this song next?!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is that a new Miku song?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
No, this one's sung by Luka.
It's really cool, and I thought you'd like it, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Really...? Then, I'll try listening to it a little.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
I wanna listen, too!
I can't wait to hear what it's like♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I can tell that they all really enjoy playing together.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'd happily keep listening to this performance forever.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It seems like they can't hear my voice in this SEKAI, so since I'm here...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
So it's still unclear when you're going to be discharged.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, but it's not all bad!
I can do my homework and stuff here, and you guys are always here to visit!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright...
We'll be back to visit soon.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Really soon.
So, Saki, please try to be patient...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me. I got you some snacks that everyone in our class has been talking about... I know you like this sort of thing.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Try them when you get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Oh, it's those milk tea flavored potato chips?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much! I've really been wanting to try these!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line: I was a little startled at first, but they're actually pretty good...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they're sweet and salty in such a way that I had a hard time stopping myself.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I was told that it's okay for me to have some snacks, so I'll give them a try later♪

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: I'll give you all my review the next time you come and visit!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Great. Okay, we'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Their footsteps are slowly fading to silence...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I know I'm in a fragment right now, so there's no way for Saki from this time to hear me... But...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Ichika told me that you've been acting strange lately. Did something happen? You can always ask me if there's anything that's bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Why did you tell me to leave you alone the other day?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: You haven't been reading my messages either. Have you been talking to Saki at all?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line: You know exactly what I meant by what I said...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line: I don't have time to hang out with you or anyone else anymore.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey, Honami! Want to walk home together?
There's a new bakery we could stop by on the way.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Please don't talk to me at school anymore.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Shiho and Hona haven't been around to visit lately.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: To be fair, this hospital is really far away...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: As lonely as I feel right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Shiho, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: I want to spend more time with them...
Oh, so this is a school SEKAI?
Not only are there many classrooms here, the view from the rooftop was spectacular.
Wait, Luka, you've already had a chance to take a look around...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did you want to come with me, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I'll let you know when I go for my next walk.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Again, it's okay.
I'll go look by myself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Ah, it's the residents of this SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Despite this SEKAI only being minutes old, they already seem to be fast friends.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, the feelings of the owners... The feelings of Ichika and the others are permeating all throughout this SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's clear that they desperately want to be together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope they come visit soon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that may be difficult for them right now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Since they're avoiding seeing each other at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because they care for one another so much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope they discover their true feelings soon...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to head up to the rooftop, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, would you like me to come with you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No... I just want a breath of fresh air.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, this SEKAI really is overflowing with their feelings...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Between these matching plushies, this group photo and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Everything here points to just how much they want to be together...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Which tells me that they forged their bonds through music.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Even now, they're likely thinking quite a lot about one another.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I mean, their feelings for each other are so strong that they gave rise to this SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't want them to lose these feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Because they're so precious...
To them, nothing can replace them.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We have to do our best for them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So that they'll all discover their true feelings and smile like they did back when this photo was taken.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't worry. I know you can do it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your wish, as well as Miku's, will come true.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Those girls will discover their true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They'll make their dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, I shouldn't be acting all fidgety...
Especially since Ichika and the others may be coming over soon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We need to do our best for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So that we can guide them down the right path.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's Haruka when she was little!

rows.Speaker: Senior Members
rows.Line: You look amazing in that outfit, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Senior Members
rows.Line: That's normal since you're going on stage for the first time today. Are you feeling okay...?

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I've been practicing really hard just for this day...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I need to go out there and spread as much hope as I can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (She genuinely wants everyone to feel hope!)

rows.Speaker: Senior Members
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's the spirit!
But you still seem a teensy bit anxious.

rows.Speaker: Senior Members
rows.Line:
You gotta smile!
The audience wants to see that beautiful smile of yours!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But why...?
I was backstage with Haruka just now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you go on stage feeling that way, you'll end up disappointing all the people that came to see us, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna put everything into my singing, dancing and MCing because I want everyone here to have the time of their lives!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to spread hope and make them believe that tomorrow will be better!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the kind of super idol I want to become!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you two are no different, right? If you are, shake those nerves and get back in the driver's seat...!

rows.Speaker: QT Member B
rows.Line:
I'm gonna try my best too!
Thank you so much, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There we go!
We're gonna blow the roof off today's event!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Wait a second...
Am I seeing everyone's first shows...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(This is it...
No mistakes. Our fans won't have any of it...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I practiced as much as I could. I know each song and dance routine now. Airi even said she'd be coming, so I need to help make this show a success...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'll be okay. I'm an idol now!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(So much cheering...!
I've never heard these kinds of roars before...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(They're really here to see me perform.
Shizuku Hinomori the idol...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I don't want to disappoint them.
I want to learn how to spread hope to all of them...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (So many people are here to watch me...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (It's like they're embracing me with their voices...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to spread hope to everyone here.)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (So that they'll all be able to do their best tomorrow!)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for joining us today...!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Let's use this time to have as much fun as we can together...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
The audience's eyes are all sparkling...
And this cheerful energy's so infectious!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They want to spread as much hope as they can as idols.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And this fragment is a representation of those three's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (This fragment just keeps getting bigger and bigger.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I hope it keeps on growing into its own SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Last time, everyone asked me questions about our shows. Today's just been TV this and TV that...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I get that me being absent from so many of our shows isn't helping but...)

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: Yu Yu, long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wish someone else were chosen instead of...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
You always do this.
You never think for yourself and just do as you're told.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You were given a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that the rest of us would do anything for, but you don't seem to care whatsoever about capitalizing on it.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You said hope was all I needed! This all happened because I kept working so hard!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
All that time I wasted...
My dream of being an idol! Give it back!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But they shined so brightly on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They were doing their best to spread hope to everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The fragment... It's starting to fade...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They all feel like they're at their limit.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: (I don't know if I can keep going on like this, but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: (I want to give it another chance...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They haven't completely given up yet...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(It's almost about to disappear...
But I can still feel their desire to spread hope to others.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I want to tell them not to give up...
I want to tell them that they are idols who can spread hope to so many people.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: I was so sure I'd pass this time...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: No, I don't have time to be feeling disappointed...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line:
I have to keep trying more and more!
Because I want to become an idol just like Haruka! I want to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow...!
Wow, look at how big this stage is...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I saw lots of stages back there, but this one seems to be the biggest!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And this crowd's huge...!
This is so cool...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's what the owners of the feeling which made this SEKAI feel...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I also want to spread hope to everyone as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know your wishes are going to come true!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone! Let's have lots and lots of fun together today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Wanting to help them but not being able to was really frustrating...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But this me is doing everything she can for them in my place.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This stage is so big and there was such a huge crowd here that I couldn't help but start singing♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What a coincidence!
I was actually just singing over on that stage♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I wish I could've seen your performance, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, it's amazing how there are all these stages here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They must all represent how Haruka and the others feel.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I hope we get to meet them soon♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They must really love idols if their feelings were able to produce this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have to also think that they're kind and wonderful people who are willing to give their all to bring others hope!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Definitely!
I mean, it's so obvious from all these stages that they really want to spread hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which means we also gotta do our best, Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We'll sing, dance, spread hope and help them discover their true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And someday, we're gonna perform on this stage with them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(They're both so cheerful and optimistic...
I feel more hopeful after just listening to them.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They may not be able to get their feelings across right away...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I know the way you two perform is going to inspire so much hope in them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's make this the best show ever♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: W-Wait, does this mean I get to see them perform...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Since I'm here, I might as well have some fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're gonna have so much fun together♪

rows.Speaker: Taiga & Ken
rows.Line:
♪ーーーーーーーー!!
♪ーー!! ーー!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're making my heart dance, and I can't seem to keep my body still...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes...!
The atmosphere in here is absolutely incredible...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is where it all began for them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm? Len isn't here.
Where could he have gone...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (I'm going to learn how to sing the way Aunt Nagi did, and then, someday, we're gonna perform on stage together...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (I'm gonna put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND...!!)

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Hey, An!
You're practicing pretty hard again today.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's because I wanna team up with Aunt Nagi someday and put on an event that's even better than RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: So, I've gotta learn how to sing a lot better!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: I'm gonna invite all of you guys, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Anyway, I wanna practice a bit more...
But...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Where could Aunt Nagi be...?
I really wanna practice with her...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
I haven't seen her at all lately.
I guess she's really busy.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: In that case, I'll just have to surprise her the next time we do see each other...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Her passion for what she does has been strong since this time. She clearly loves singing and Nagi very much.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
(I managed to win, but just barely.
That means I still need to practice more.)

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
I just saw your performance!
You sounded amazing. I can tell that you're set on surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
But I still have a lot of work left to do. I'm just glad that I was able to win today.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Haha. I actually kind of disagree with you there!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: So, how would you like to team up with me...? I bet the two of us could blow some people away!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I'm not actually looking for a partner right now.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Okay...
But let me know when you do start looking.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (It'd be great to find someone similar to Aunt Nagi's teammates. A partner who can sing with me and pursue the same dream.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (But I'm yet to meet anyone who makes me think that they're the one...)

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Our big debut event finally happens next week!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's a battle, so we gotta go blow the roof off the place!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: They sound like Dad and his team. I wish...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: No, I will find a partner someday...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She had to endure so much even during this time...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All in order to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This couldn't have been easy for her...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But there's no need for you to worry.
That's because...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your singing has the power to change the future.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did everyone's feelings help create this cafe...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But no one else seems to be here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's an assortment of coffee beans and tea leaves here. And the refrigerator appears to be full of cooking ingredients...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For now, I think I'll brew myself a cup...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(But this cafe seems completely empty...
Is this the moment just after this SEKAI was created?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, the beans are all ground up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, what a lovely aroma...
I'm sure this coffee is going to taste wonderful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I sensed a powerful desire while walking through those alleyways just now...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND... The flyers I saw must've been for that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't know what kind of event it actually was, but I'm sure it was something spectacular...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The owners of these feelings... An and the others... They're probably singing and practicing right now in order to accomplish that goal.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. For one, I'm sure they all love to sing, and are very passionate about what they do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Does that also mean this cafe has a special place in their hearts?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If so, I'll need to handle this place with great care...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I guess this SEKAI's version of me has always been a skilled barista...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It really is a lovely aroma.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO...
Did you just brew up some coffee?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I did. Would you like a cup as well, Miku?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Just give me one second.
Okay, here you are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You could probably start your own cafe if you're this good at brewing coffee, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and this place just happens to be vacant, so why not give it a go?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Especially since this place was probably made with them in mind...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I also have a feeling that this cafe is going to be important to them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want this cafe to be a place where they can relax.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since the place they're aiming for is so high up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want to provide an oasis where they can go when they're feeling tired after practice, having a tough time or worrying about something.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want this cafe to be that kind of place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And I'm sure it will be...
After all, MEIKO, you're a great listener.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. If you're willing to give me your seal of approval, Miku, then I guess I don't have anything to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I am pretty picky about these things.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I'm looking forward to everyone coming to visit this cafe for the first time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, so am I...
Before they do, I'll need to come up with a menu that they'll really enjoy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Starting with... Maybe my own original blend?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I'll be looking forward to the way that turns out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She seems like such a reliable person...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And you're right.
This cafe is going to have a very special place in their hearts.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, please help them out for me... Me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO, if you're going to run a cafe, then I think you'll want to have some food on the menu and not just coffee.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
They're bound to get hungry after their practices.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm not sure about how everything is going to taste.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I say just give it a try.
I'll be here to taste test everything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Is that another way of saying that you're hungry, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm in a different place now...?
But I was watching RAD WEEKEND just a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Even during today's event, I couldn't get a good response...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I've been practicing and running every day. I'm even projecting my voice better, so I feel like my singing skills have improved...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But I still haven't been able to reach anyone yet.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Wait, is this Akito from when he was in...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (How do I become a better singer?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: At this rate, I'm never going to surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Whoever's performing is maintaining a perfect pitch like a machine, but hardly singing by the book... If anything, it sounds pretty rough. Almost like...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(I don't recognize him...
And he doesn't seem all that used to singing.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (He seems pretty affluent, but he's singing like there's no tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I can't look away for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is how those two first met.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I didn't know Akito went over to watch Toya sing every day like this.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
Now I'm really interested.
Hey, how would you like to try singing together?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: (My body feels like it's on fire now for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(I knew it...
Singing together like this has made it all clear.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (He's a good singer, but that's not all...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They've got these serious looks on their faces, but they seem to be having a lot of fun together...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Hey, promise to come back soon.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I'll be waiting for you right here.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line:
Akito, about this part...
I feel like we should sing it together instead of you going solo.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that might make it sound more powerful. Let's give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
Toya, that reminds me.
How about we try entering into an event?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm able to do so much better when I sing with him.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (His perfect pitch and ability to maintain a steady rhythm are important, but he understands what a song is about and uses his voice to hit you with it...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (My guess is he's doing that all subconsciously...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (It might not be just a dream anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (With him, just maybe. We could surpass RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Hey, wanna try surpassing RAD WEEKEND with me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So this is how Akito and Toya started pursuing this dream...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Singing both brought them together and helped them become good friends...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (They really seem like the best partners for one another, but I guess they saw something in each other right off the bat.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey...
This looks like a fun SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's even a bunch of stuff drawn on the walls everywhere...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Pretty sure it's called “graffiti” or something.
That's really cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I knew it! That's me, but this SEKAI's version!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...! This must be what the owners of these feelings want to...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right. This is that legendary event...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I have no idea what it was like, but it seems pretty amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, have you already checked everything out around here?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Isn't this place so exciting?!
It's like there's music everywhere!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you think it all has to do with this event? With RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The owners of these feelings... Akito and the others are probably all singing and practicing really hard in order to surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin!
Why don't we also practice?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Imagine everyone coming over with questions about singing but we aren't able to help them. That'd be kind of a problem, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna become a way better singer, so I'll be able to help them when that happens!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means we gotta make sure we're as good as they are!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You too, Rin!
Next, let's kick it up a notch!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, we harmonized so well just now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! There's definitely nothing wrong with our teamwork! We should be able to help everyone whenever they need us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess these two were also good partners since day one...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Which explains why they've been able to help Akito and the others so much.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (And I'm sure these two will keep doing a great job with them moving forward!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My throat's starting to feel really parched after all that singing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
Wanna check out that cafe?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I just saw Miku and MEIKO getting everything ready inside!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They might be all finished now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, where did MEIKO go? We originally ended up in this SEKAI together...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Maybe I'll find her at the cafe.
I've gotta follow them!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you already heard?
I was just in the middle of mixing up some drinks.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I knew I'd find you here, MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Len, did you come here with them?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup!
Guess what? I got to see the moment when Akito and Toya first met.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
They were so cool!
Even back then, they took singing really seriously as they pursued their dream together...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see.
I got to see An...and not just her, either.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She also took her singing very seriously.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! I guess that's just how they've always been, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They didn't know each other all that well back then, but they ended up producing this one SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Their feelings must've been just that strong.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But the way they meet, face their true feelings and make their dream come true does make for quite a story.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But things are just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're about to take their feelings and set out into the world!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll keep watching over them, so I hope you keep giving them all the support you can...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I knew that fragment-like object would send me somewhere, but why a hospital...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“I'm not about to lose!
I will win this battle!!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Yes, it's Tsukasa and Saki when they were little...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm still not sure why, but it seems that I've been sent back to one of their old memories.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They both seem to be having so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm sensing a particularly strong desire coming from Tsukasa.)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
It was so nice to see Saki smiling.
Thank you for putting such a fun show on for us, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome!
I spent a lot of time coming up with it just for Saki!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm glad that I got to see Saki smile today.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm going to start coming up with my next show after we get home!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (He wants to make someone smile, just like the show he saw with Saki when they were little...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is this the fragment that's destined to blossom into that SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope that desire keeps growing stronger and stronger...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: “And so, after saving the planet, the Pegasus Adventurers decided to travel into outer space.”

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: What?! They went into outer space?!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's right!
But don't worry! Next up is the Milky Way arc, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hehe. They seem to be having an enjoyable time again today...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Plus, that story was so grand and imaginative, just like Tsukasa himself. I couldn't help but smile.)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for always coming up with these shows for me, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: You always make things super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm going to keep coming up with special shows that make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Really?
But isn't that gonna be really hard?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, because I'm going to become the biggest star in the world!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to come up with even more shows, and make you and so many other people smile and laugh, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know you will, Tsukasa!
So, do your best!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh, that fragment's starting to glow even brighter...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa's show was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it was. He's always coming up with entertaining shows, but the one he did today was particularly good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Prince Pegasus was really cool, and so was Officer Rabbit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He totally got flung halfway around the world, but it was amazing to see him come flying back when Prince Pegasus was in a pickle!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really wanna try doing that☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try our hand at that show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Tsukasa had to cover multiple roles all by himself, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We have so many plushies here to help.
I believe we should be able to turn his story into a very grand show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's see... It begins with Prince Pegasus and Officer Rabbit meeting in the park!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, then, I'll be standing stage left.
Miku, you take stage right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I guess the us from this SEKAI also love doing shows...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hehe. I have to think this is another reflection of Tsukasa's feelings.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to seeing how their show turns out.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “And so, after saving the planet, the Pegasus Adventurers decided to travel into outer space!”

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It was a good show.
Especially the way you all danced, plushies.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really wanna do this show with Tsukasa, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Doing this show with all of you guys was super fun, but I think Tsukasa being here would make things just that much better...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I do agree with you on that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Moreover...
I hope we get to start doing shows with him after he discovers his true feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. They're finally going to meet him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, wait a second...
Tsukasa doesn't actually come over to SEKAI until years from now...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... What should I make my next show about...?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh! I might be able to use that stick over there for my next show!!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Prince Pegasus will wield it...!
I dub thee the Special Sky Legend Pegasus Sword!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's got a good ring to it!
I can start working on a show based on that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... Did we come at the wrong time...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No matter!
We'll just have to do better next time to grab his attention☆>

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I could use what they just talked about for my show! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Tsukasa! I wanna do a show with you!>

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, someone's calling!
What if it's about Saki...?!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hello?! You've reached the Tenmas!
Oh, Toya, it's you...!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Actually, you called at the perfect time!
I'm working on my next show and was wondering if you...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: What was that just now...? Wait, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-No, I dropped my phone in that puddle...! I hope it's not broken...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I don't understand!
Why isn't Tsukasa noticing me?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And now, we won't be able to see him until his phone gets repaired...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I didn't think you'd be this invisible to him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't think you need to feel so anxious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa's doing his best to come up with another show for Saki right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, for now, we may want to just watch over him and give his feelings time to develop further.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They've been watching over Tsukasa and keeping an eye on his feelings ever since he was little...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still, not being able to talk to him due to all those near misses must've been frustrating...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
She really enjoyed my last show!
So, I'll try coming up with a sequel for it...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Saki's hospital is so far away now. I'm getting fewer chances to do shows for her...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, if I have time to mope, then I have time to hone my acting skills...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line: Plus, Saki has Ichika and the others...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I should focus on becoming the world's greatest star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that was an excellent piece of acting I did just now, was it not?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. The day I become the greatest star in the world is just around the corner! Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wh-What do we do...?! It's like Tsukasa only cares about becoming the world's greatest star now...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Do you think this has anything to do with the person he was trying to make smile being sent far away...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <He's become so enamored with becoming a star that she's ended up having to take a back seat...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We can't let things continue like this...!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Tsukasa! Tsukasa!
Please notice “Untitled” on your phone!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sally sells seashells by the seashore!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
*Cry*
Tsukasa's forgotten about his true feelings...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does this mean he's never ever going to learn about this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I don't think he's completely forgotten...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, he still cares deeply about doing shows...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure he'll be fine as long as that holds true...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, until he does remember his true feelings, let's keep trying to talk to him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After all, isn't that why we're here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For his sake, I'm gonna keep trying my best!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Is there anything we can do to help him?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, he might remember if he met some people who feel the same way as him!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What if we tried searching for them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (People who feel the same way as him...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Right...
He'll meet Emu and the others soon.)

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: But how do we find them...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm...
What if we tried popping over to the phones of people who seem to fit that description...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's try brainstorming with the other plushies!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, I'll join you all in a minute.
Feel free to start without me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure things will work out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This SEKAI came to be because Tsukasa genuinely wishes to make others smile through his shows...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He may've forgotten about that temporarily, but I'm sure he'll remember...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, he is the one who produced this spectacular SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And Miku's right.
Those who feel the same way as him will also come visit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Emu, Nene and Rui...
They're all wonderful people with good and pure intentions.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They'll help Tsukasa rediscover his true feelings and begin their journey as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you keep at it and believe in them, things will turn out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We need to do our best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To make sure Tsukasa rediscovers his true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You came so close on this test, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I know...
I miscalculated on one problem.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I apologize for dashing your hopes.
I promise to be more careful next time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, it is a bit of a shame since you knew how to solve the problem.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You'll need to focus on your studies much more if you really do intend to become a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm going up to my room to review what I did wrong.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Okay. Keep doing your best, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I need to study...
I have to get a perfect score next time.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So that I can become a doctor...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's see... The problem I got wrong was...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(This cake doesn't taste like much to me.
Mom said it was good, though, so it must be.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But it's not just the cake.
Everything tastes a little bland lately, even restaurant food and Mom's cooking.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wonder if I'm just overthinking this. Maybe I should do something I like to get my mind off things for a while.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Haha. How strange. I must just be tired from studying so much.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I still need to listen to that song everyone was telling me about yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: They said it's really bright and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: What exactly is a cheerful song?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: What was it I liked? What did I want to do again?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What are the things that I like...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: We're having beef stew for dinner tonight, Mafuyu. I know it's your favorite. Please have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, I will.
Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Mafuyu?
You don't look very excited.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, is it by chance not to your liking?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
N-No, nothing's wrong.
I was just thinking about something, is all.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, here's that book you lent me the other day. It was really interesting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate
rows.Line:
Really?!
That's great! I had a feeling you'd like it, Mafuyu! Can you tell me what your favorite scene was?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
My favorite scene...?
I thought they were all very good, but...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (No matter what I do... No matter who I talk to, I keep feeling that something's wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's as if I'm talking about someone other than myself.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And the things I say that I like are really...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So, what does it mean to be me...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (How do I find out who the real me is...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is this a fragment of a feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on her desire to find out who the real her is...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I've listened to a lot of different songs now, but they don't do what this one does...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (K's song has such a cold and dark tone to it, but I feel compelled by it for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why is it that only K's makes me feel this way...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: None of the other songs have had this effect on me, and I don't understand why...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I just don't know...
And there's no way for me to learn why.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even if I were to ask someone about this...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Would the person who wrote this song know...?)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I doubt I would've been able to do this without you. It encapsulates what I was hoping to express now thanks to you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I see...
I'm glad I could help.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What were you trying to express with this song?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yes, you mentioned how this song needed to feel more stagnant. That may be the best way to look at this.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Not a harsh sense of despair, but something more silent and gradual...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (A SEKAI is ready to be born...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's so quiet, and there's no one else...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She wants to find... The real her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
This SEKAI is empty because she doesn't know who the real her is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She must be in so much pain...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what I can do for her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'll try doing what I can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Looks like a music file.
Who sent it to me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?! Why did the screen just flash?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So this was how Mafuyu and this SEKAI's version of me met for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She doesn't know who the real her is, and desperately wants to find out...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But that's much easier said than done...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (At this point in time, Mafuyu has no idea what her true feelings are.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Simultaneously, this SEKAI's me wasn't really sure how she was going to help her.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought writing a song would help me discover my true feelings, but I'm still having trouble...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because it's based on my feelings...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you think I'll ever know...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll help you find the real you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can I stay here for a little while longer...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is your SEKAI after all, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This SEKAI ends up becoming a very important place for Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Naturally, for this version of me as well...)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I listened to your mix of that song, Yuki. Thank you for doing that.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Thank you, K.
What did you think...?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <It was much deeper than I was expecting. I thought I was being tossed into this dark and quiet chasm of despair.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <But I also felt like I was searching for the light. That was really well done...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Hehe. That was present in the demo you made, K. All I did was add a few more sounds on top of that...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Still, I believe you've helped make it a lot better. So, Yuki, thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I felt something while listening to this song too, but I still haven't found what I'm looking for...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I really appreciate you always helping me, Asahina, but I feel bad about making you do this during your lunch break.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, this is nothing.
You needed me to carry these papers over to the classroom, yes?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, that would be incredibly helpful!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I heard from your teacher that you've decided to become a class representative, Mafuyu. Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
Everyone said that I should take the job.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm so proud of you.
Be sure to do your very best, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But try not to be too helpful either, since those receiving your assistance won't be able to grow as individuals.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'll be careful.
Thanks for the warning, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've looked and looked, but still haven't found any answers...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This void inside of me just keeps growing and growing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Now... I just want to disappear...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I can't find them after searching this much...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then I can't help but wonder if they exist at all...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just want to stay in this SEKAI forever.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to help Mafuyu find her true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But that won't happen at this rate...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's the one by that person Mafuyu's been working with...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI is completely empty, with the exception of this song...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The person who made this song might be able to help find the real Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I'll go see her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For trying so hard all by yourself in this empty SEKAI, just for her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For doing your best to keep her feelings safe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't do anything to help...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'll always be watching over you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just now... I felt all this warmth...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, we are!
I wish I could've stayed a little longer...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
But it was nice to see what that SEKAI was like back then.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I didn't realize just how long those other versions of us had been watching over everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, they were all doing their best to make sure everyone would discover their true feelings!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And coming up with ways to help support them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They were working really hard to make sure they'd be there for everyone when that time came.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not being able to get the others to realize that SEKAI existed did become a little frustrating at times.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they kept doing their best to help everyone despite their struggles.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And they've become a huge source of support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then and now, including this very moment...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did the sprouts in their SEKAI just grow bigger...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This must also be one of SEKAI's powers.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
What kind of plant do you think they are?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Woooow!!
This place is so pretty!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Where are we?
It doesn't look like anyone's SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This could be a new SEKAI that was collectively born out of all of their feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I've actually been here before.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You need to see this tree!
Everyone's feelings are hanging from it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right...!
And they all involve different things...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Is this a CD...?
Oh, it's Leo/need's debut single.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I found some pictures of Minori and the others, and some of their merch!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Check it out, MEIKO!
There's a flyer for RAD BLAST!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm finding posters Tsukasa and his troupe made for their shows as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
There's a pile of sheet music over here...
Oh, and some apples.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There really are a lot of things hanging from this tree. And they're all clear representations of everyone's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Their feelings, along with ours, made it grow this big.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, when you look at it as a whole, it does feel like we overcame a lot together to help make their dreams come true. That makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And it's grown so much since the last time I was here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That must be a reflection of just how much everyone else has grown.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's growing with them...?
That's so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it is! Also, that means it's gonna keep growing bigger and bearing more fruits!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll definitely be looking forward to seeing that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(A SEKAI made out of everybody's feelings...
And it changes little by little as they grow.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wonder what's going to happen here moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I can't say for certain right now...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'd like to keep watching over them...!
